items.scheme: Nippon India CRISIL-IBX SDL - June 2037 Index Fund
items.objective: A target maturity index fund that aims to generate returns corresponding to the total returns of the securities in the CRISIL-IBX SDL Index – June 2037, before expenses and subject to tracking error.

items.scheme: HDFC Charity Fund for Cancer Cure (Feb 2030)
items.benchmark: NIFTY Medium Duration Debt Index A-III
items.exit_load: Not applicable (close-ended; units listed on exchange)
items.objective: A close-ended income scheme with a tenure of 1,169 days that seeks to generate income by investing in debt and money market instruments and government securities maturing on or before the scheme's maturity date. Part of the income distributed is donated towards cancer treatment.

items.scheme: Invesco India BSE Top 10 Banks ETF
items.objective: A passively managed exchange traded fund that invests in equity and equity-related securities replicating the composition of the BSE Top 10 Banks Index, subject to tracking error.

items.scheme: Invesco India Nifty Metal Index Fund
items.objective: An index fund that invests passively in equity and equity-related securities replicating the composition of the Nifty Metal Index, subject to tracking error.

items.fund_manager: Satish Dondapati, Jeetu Valechha Sonar, Abhishek Bisen
items.objective: An index fund that aims to provide returns, before expenses, corresponding to the total returns of the securities in the Nifty Pharma Index, subject to tracking error.

items.scheme: SBI BSE India Defence ETF FOF
items.exit_load: 1% if redeemed within 15 days of allotment; nil after 15 days
items.objective: A fund of funds that seeks to provide returns closely corresponding to those of the SBI BSE India Defence ETF, by investing in units of that ETF.

items.exit_load: 1% if redeemed or switched out within 6 months of allotment; nil after 6 months
items.objective: A dynamic asset allocation fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by actively shifting its allocation between equity and equity-related instruments and debt and money market securities.

items.exit_load: 1% if redeemed or switched out within 3 months of allotment; nil after 3 months
items.fund_manager: Sorbh Gupta, Bharat Hegde (equity); Siddharth Chaudhary (debt)
items.objective: A thematic equity scheme that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing in equity and equity-related securities, shifting allocation across sectors and stocks according to the stage of the business cycle.

An index fund that aims to replicate the Nifty Commodities Index by holding its constituents in the same proportion, seeking returns before expenses that track the index's total return, subject to tracking error.

items.scheme: Baroda BNP Paribas Balanced Hybrid Fund
items.exit_load: Within 1 year of allotment: nil on up to 10% of units, 1% on units beyond that; nil after 1 year
items.fund_manager: Silky Jain, Kirtan Mehta (equity); Prashant Pimple, Vikram Pamnani (debt)
items.objective: A balanced hybrid scheme that seeks long-term capital appreciation and income through an actively managed portfolio split between equity and equity-related instruments and debt and money market instruments (40–60% each). No arbitrage is permitted.

items.scheme: Invesco India Financial Services Debt Fund
items.benchmark: CRISIL Financial Services Short Term Debt Index
items.objective: A debt scheme that seeks to generate income by investing predominantly in debt and debt-related instruments issued by companies in the financial services sector, across durations.

items.exit_load: 1% if redeemed within 30 days of allotment; nil after 30 days
items.objective: An equity scheme that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing in equity and equity-related instruments using a contrarian investment strategy.

items.exit_load: 0.25% if redeemed or switched out within 15 days of allotment; nil after 15 days
items.fund_manager: Yogik Pitti (equity); Bhupesh Kalyani, Suman Prasad (fixed income)
items.objective: An arbitrage scheme that seeks to generate income mainly from arbitrage opportunities between the cash and derivatives segments of the equity market, with the balance in permitted debt instruments.

items.fund_manager: Ramesh Mantri, Ashish Agrawal, Dheeresh Pathak, Trupti Agarwal, Piyush Baranwal
items.objective: An equity scheme that seeks long-term capital appreciation from a diversified portfolio of equity and equity-related instruments selected using a contrarian investing strategy.

items.exit_load: 1% if redeemed within 1 month of allotment; nil after 1 month
items.objective: An equity scheme that seeks long-term capital appreciation from a diversified portfolio invested predominantly in large-cap and mid-cap stocks, with some flexibility to hold other equity securities.
